page.layout: One page of text in a single column; a small marginal note at the left margin beside the paragraph beginning "Quemadmodum". Running head at the top with the page number at the top left.

main_text.p: ceri debent? Quòd etiam caufas obscuritatis multorum scripturæ locorum commemoras, id sententiam nostram non euertit. Sint sanè multa in Sacris literis difficilia, quæ etiam doctos exercent: non pauca tamen adeò perspicua sunt, partim per se, partim fideli piorum & doctorum interpretum in Sacris literis conferendis industria, & rei experientia, vt etiam à vulgo, adhibita diligentia, intelligi, & vtiliter explicari possint. Nam (vt reliqua sileam) quid in Sacris literis obscurius Apocalypsi Iohannis? at tamen non tota (vt falsò iudicas) inexplicabili obscuritate latet inuoluta: sed multa complectitur, quæ partim sua luce perspicua, partim prophetiarum euentu illustrata sunt. Quare non omnis Sacrarum literarum interpretatio vulgo deroganda est, quod ex sequentibus clarius constabit.
main_text.head: COSTERVS.
main_text.p: QVEMADMODVM igitur ars nulla sine magistro discitur, neque auctor etiam profanus sine studio intelligitur; ita nec Scripturæ cognitio, sine labore Scripturæ à magistris discendæ.

page.notes: The marginal note at the left reads "Scripturæ à magistris discendæ." The first line of the Costerus paragraph is set beside the note; the paragraph continues on the next page with "labore" at the end of the visible text. Some words in the upper lines are slightly blurred.
